{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Sage green silk crepe midi dress with a draped neckline and a flowing A-line silhouette in color #5A6E5D.
Tan suede ankle boots with a moderate block heel and a pointed toe in color #C19B7D.
Gold vermeil drop earrings with hammered texture and small pearl accents.
This outfit strikes the perfect balance for an upscale wedding at noon, where the formal dress code demands elegance without overheating guests under daylight conditions. The flowing silhouette complements a festive lunch while the earthy tonal palette harmonizes beautifully with her warm skin tones and autumnal hair. It respects the occasion's formality through refined fabric choices and architectural details that elevate the look beyond standard daytime wear."}
